name: campusorbit
description: CampusOrbit — from confusion to career-ready. A MERN platform that gives students one clear path, one curated video per topic, honest preparation tracking and a real placement pipeline.
_comment_workspaces: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace. server/ and client/ install independently via `npm --prefix`, each with its own lockfile. Declaring workspaces here made npm hoist packages to the root and skip platform-specific optional dependencies (npm/cli#4828), which broke `vite` on Windows with 'Cannot find module @rollup/rollup-win32-x64-msvc'.

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:socket
scripts.test:all: node server/test-api.mjs && node server/test-socket.mjs && node server/test-client-endpoints.mjs && node server/test-chat-2session.mjs && node server/test-watch-sync.mjs && node server/test-race-conditions.mjs && node server/test-onboarding-loop.mjs && node server/test-meet.mjs
